posts.zh:
dsh-shutdown-after-task 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。任务完成后自动关机：右下角按钮开启模式，任务成功完成后进入可取消的倒计时（取消走 shutdown /a），零运行时依赖。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-9275e7a4721f373d0b89.html
posts.en:
dsh-shutdown-after-task is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Shut down Windows automatically after DeepSeek Harness tasks complete — a floating arm button plus a cancellable countdown banner (shutdown /a), zero runtime dependencies.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-9275e7a4721f373d0b89.html
